about: TF2 models the player can pick for their launcher viewmodel and their rockets. export_models.py reads each from the player's own TF2 (nothing is shipped). Launchers come from items_game.txt model_player (item_class tf_weapon_rocketlauncher*/particle_cannon); projectiles are TF2's hard-coded rocket/energy-ball w_models found in the VPKs.

columns.name: shown in the F8 panel
columns.extra: more models drawn with it (TF2 festive lights are a separate model on top of the stock launcher)
columns.fire_sound: TF2 soundscript entry for a shot (items_game visuals sound_single_shot; stock weapons: their weapon script's single_shot)
columns.explode_sound: TF2 soundscript entry for the blast (items_game sound_special1 when it is an explosion, else TF2's BaseExplosionEffect.Sound)
columns.fire_waves: the files behind fire_sound in TF2's VPKs (resolved from game_sounds_weapons.txt by the sheet tool; TF2 picks one at random)
